Help.title: Help
Help.contactText: For technical issues or questions, contact your Integris administrator or reach us at
Help.step1Body: Go to Upload and drag-and-drop or select a PDF. Integris accepts invoices from any ERP or accounting system.
Help.step2Body: The system runs OCR to extract text, then uses AI to parse invoice fields (seller, buyer, line items, totals, VAT). This usually takes under 30 seconds.
Help.step3Body: Every document goes through a review step before it can be submitted. Open the document, verify the extracted fields against the PDF, correct any errors, and click Approve.
Help.step4Body: After approval, Integris generates a KSeF-compliant FA(3) XML file deterministically from the approved data. The AI is never used for this step.
Help.step5Body: The XML is submitted to KSeF. Integris polls for the official UPO receipt and updates the document status. You can download the UPO from the audit trail.
Help.faq1A: Yes. OCR and AI extraction can produce errors, especially on scanned or low-quality PDFs. Always review extracted fields before approving.
Help.faq2Q: What happens if KSeF rejects the invoice?
Help.faq2A: The document moves to the rejected status. You can correct the extracted data and retry submission from the review screen.
Help.faq3Q: Is the FA(3) XML generated by AI?
Help.faq3A: No. XML is generated by a deterministic algorithm from approved structured data. AI is only used for text extraction, never for the final XML.
Help.faq4A: This is controlled by your server configuration (KSEF_ENV). Contact your administrator to confirm whether you are in dry-run, sandbox, or production mode.

hero.title: KSeF is mandatory. Your ERP isn't going anywhere.
hero.subtitle: Integris exists because Polish companies are facing a compliance deadline — and most of them cannot, or should not, replace their entire ERP to meet it. We built the bridge instead.

problem.regulationBody: KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur — requires all Polish VAT-registered companies to issue structured electronic invoices through the national platform. Non-compliance is not an option. The format, submission process, and validation rules are defined by the Ministry of Finance.
problem.realityBody: Most companies run legacy ERP systems, Excel workflows, or accounting software that was never designed to speak KSeF. A full platform migration is expensive, disruptive, and frequently unnecessary. The existing system works — it just needs a compliant output layer.

what.body: Integris is a middleware layer that sits between your existing invoice workflow and KSeF. It ingests PDF invoices, extracts structured data using OCR and AI, validates it, routes it through human review, generates compliant FA(3) XML deterministically, and submits it to KSeF — without touching your ERP.

items.title: Human-in-the-loop
items.body: AI extracts, humans approve. No invoice reaches KSeF without an operator reviewing and signing off on the data. AI assists — it never decides.

items.title: Deterministic output
items.body: FA(3) XML is generated by a rule-based algorithm from approved structured data. AI is never used for the final XML — compliance output is always predictable and auditable.

items.title: Full auditability
items.body: Every upload, correction, approval, and submission is recorded in an immutable audit trail. The system is transparent by design — not as an afterthought.

items.title: Strict data isolation
items.body: Every document belongs to exactly one company. Multi-tenant isolation is enforced at the architecture level — not by convention or policy.

future.label: Where we're going
future.body: KSeF compliance is the entry point. The longer opportunity is operational orchestration — connecting legacy accounting workflows to modern, AI-assisted infrastructure. The architecture is built to grow in that direction without ever compromising the core principle:
future.highlight: AI assists, humans decide, and every action is auditable.

sections.body: Integris does not perform autonomous accounting operations without user oversight.
bullets: Data confirmed before further processing
Every document reviewed by an operator

Full operational control on the user side

sections.title: Audit logs & operation history

bullets: Full audit trails for every document
Change history attributed to each user
Monitoring of all workflow stages
Enterprise-grade operational transparency

sections.title: AI-assisted workflows
sections.body: AI in Integris supports data extraction and validation. The system does not make autonomous business or accounting decisions without user involvement.
bullets: AI used exclusively for data extraction and normalisation
Every AI result requires human verification
Deterministic XML generation — no AI involved

sections.title: Data security

Role-based access control (owner / operator / viewer)
Data separation between organisations (multi-tenant)
Secure PDF document storage in isolated storage

Compliance with KSeF requirements (Polish e-invoice)
Operational transparency required by regulated environments
